messages:
maria_cs: Auriga Sensorium reached out — wants to onboard a custom NER + summarizer model for sensor logs. Contains sensor IDs + occasional PHI fields. They requested private deployment (VPC) and a safety eval before go-live. Renewal in 6 weeks; if we don't start onboarding now they flagged potential renewal risk. Assign?

akash_se: I'll take lead on model compatibility. @dana_security we'll need the privacy checklist. What model size and format are they sending? llama/peft/ONNX?

dana_security: PHI present — must be on Private with KMS keys. Need a signed DPA and CSV of data categories. Also propose token-level redaction tests. I'll share checklist: /drive/rdw/security/phi-checklist v1.2

sam_prod: We should avoid a full private on-prem until we run safety evals on hosted-dedicated. What SLOs do they need? latency p95 < 300ms? throughput ~200 qps?

maria_cs: They're fine with p95 < 500ms, but cost ceiling is strict. They prefer a quantized 8-bit model if quality holds. Also wants hallucination/regression tests.

akash_se: Ask for a 1k-row eval set with labeled spans + 200 multi-turn summaries. Can we do eval harness on dedicated with 13B quantized? @eval-bot can queue an initial run.

eval-bot: Queued eval: auriga/initial_ner_summ_v1 — model=redwood-13b-8q, dataset=auriga_eval_v1. ETA ~ 4h. Results will be posted to /evals/1971034567.

dana_security: Reminder: full audit logs + KMS integration must be validated before private deploy. Also need model provenance — confirm open checkpoint license.

sam_prod: If eval passes we propose canary on dedicated, then escalate to Private. Also recommend canary traffic = 5% with auto-fallback to hosted 3.1b.

ops_jules: Scheduling onboarding kickoff: Tue 10am PT. I'm adding tasks: 1) DPA signoff, 2) dataset upload link, 3) eval run, 4) canary config. Icc: @maria_cs @akash_se @dana_security

maria_cs: Added customer expectations doc to thread: https://redwood.atlassian/auriga/onboard. They asked for an enablement session for their dev team.

akash_se: For dataset upload share S3 presigned with encryption; example command:
```
aws s3 cp auriga_eval_v1.json s3://redwood-onboard/auriga/ --sse aws:kms
```

maria_cs: :thumbsup: I'll send presigned by EOD. One more: Auriga asked if we can include L2 support during first month (they're on enterprise).

sam_prod: Yes, include 2-week L2 post-go-live, then standard support. We should document renewal impact: if onboarding starts this week renewal likely to close as-is; delay = high churn risk.

dana_security: I'll review DPA + KMS config tomorrow. If anything blocks, will update here. :eyes:

maria_cs: Great — next update after eval results. Thanks team.
